cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me finish the lunch question. The soup was excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you will get a complete lunch answer first. The soup was slightly salty, but I'd order it again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forget lunch. Did you eat the cake?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the questions in order. You asked whether lunch was good, and yes: the soup alone was worth going out for. Write down yes before you move on.

reason: Keep one actually established earlier lunch question, sincerely answered each time, while A directs sequence and recording to avoid the dangerous direct cake question.
